context:
EDUCATION 
BARANEETHARAN R 
Phone: 91-9087354166 |Email: baraneetharan.r2024cse@sece.ac.in |Linkedin 
Sri Eshwar College of Engineering. B. E. (CSE) 2024-2028 
Narayana JEE Academy HSC 2022-2024 
Nava Bharath National School SSLC 2021-2022 
 
INTERNSHIPS 
DELTAWARE SOLUTIONS PVT. LIMITED 2024 
 Worked as a Cybersecurity Research Intern at Deltaware, assisting with SOC monitoring and threat analysis.
 Gained practical experience in incident response and cybersecurity tools, strengthening my understanding of 
real-world security challenges
PROJECTS 
Simple File Injector 2025 
 Developed a full-featured simulation environment to demonstrate how keyloggers are embedded into files like PDFs, 
DOCXs, and images for educational purposes. 
 Designed as a safe, hands-on lab tool for cybersecurity students, blue teams, and ethical hackers to practice detection, 
defence, and digital forensics.
AI Chatbot Agent 2025 
 Designed and implemented an AI-powered conversational agent capable of understanding and responding to user inputs 
in natural language.
 The chatbot handles various user queries and automates responses using NLP techniques.
NetSentinel (Malware Scanner for Websites) 2024 
 Developed a desktop -based website malware scanner using Python and Tkinter. Implemented features like SSL 
certificate validation, malware script detection, security header analysis, blacklist checks, and Google Safe Browsing 
integration.
 Enhanced threat detection and reporting through a user-friendly GUI.
 
ACHIEVEMENTS 
 FINALIST at Mumbai’s Largest CTF – CYBERSTROM
 PicoCTF - solved 150+ problems
 Try Hack Me – top 3%
 Hack The Box – solved 15+ problems
 Cyber Defender - 10+ labs Solved
 Skillrack - 1000+ programs
 
SKILLS 
 Languages : C, Python, HTML, CSS, JS
 Databases: MySQL,Mongodb
 Tools: VScode, GitHub, Figma, Canva, WordPress
 Operating system: Kali, Remux, Metasploitable,
 Hands-On: Nmap, hashcat, Cyberchef, Zenmap, Tor
 
LEADERSHIP 
 Active Member of WICYS (Women in Cyber Security)
 IGEN green pledge badge
 Supporting Member of scouts and Guides

